The mental-state element of burglary is the intent, at the moment of unlawful entry into a building, to commit a felony inside, whether or not that felony is carried out; courts usually infer it from conduct and circumstances. In England and Wales the equivalent is Theft Act 1968 s.9(1)(a), which requires intent to steal, inflict grievous bodily harm, or cause criminal damage. The team note about future interests doesn't apply here, since it concerns property law rather than burglary.

CONFIDENCE: 85
